title: I’ve been building Merge Tactics in my spare time—looking for gameplay feedback
author: Firm_Kiwi8959
selftext:
Hey everyone! I’ve been working on **Merge Tactics** as a passion project in my free time since July 2026, and I’d love some feedback on the prototype.

You merge and reposition archers, choose powerups, and defend your Gate against waves of monsters. It’s **best played on mobile**.

I’m especially curious: does merging feel satisfying, do the choices feel meaningful, and where does the difficulty get frustrating? Honest criticism is welcome!

**Play here:** https://vingator.itch.io/merge-tactics

Quick note: IAP and ad rewards grant items immediately for testing—no payment or watching ads required.

Thanks for giving it a try!
